title: 第64章 民俗小镇
content_zh:
第64章 民俗小镇-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》

存书签

下一章

一人一鬼正在玩着搭积木，只见念念小手轻轻一点，积木就慢悠悠地飞了起来，精准地落在想要搭的位置上，李月芽在一旁看的大呼神奇。

“哇，念念好厉害！”

李月芽情绪价值提供的非常到位，念念表现的欲望更加强烈了。

吴姜半靠在念念的公主房门框上，看向李月芽，问道：“说吧，大清早的闯我家，找我到底什么事？”

李月芽头也不抬，理直气壮的说道：“我元旦有三天假呢，你陪我出去玩！”

吴姜犹豫了一下，很快就点了点头，答应了。

两人已经好久没有单独出去玩过了，今年暑假，因为两人赌气的原因，连面都没有见一次。

而且，李月芽平时要上课，只有放假的时候，才有时间，他想换个别的时间，都不可能。

李月芽早就选好地方了，是新开的一个民俗小镇，离绿城大概两百来公里，她来的时候，已经笃定吴姜会答应，将行李和吴姜的车，都开来了。

念念同样欢天喜地，虽然知道自己白天不能出来，但一听说能出去玩，就兴奋得不行。

好在李月芽身上带着吴姜画的护身符，能暂时抵挡念念身上的阴气，虽然管不了太长时间，但短时间内，一人一鬼接触，还是没有问题的。

李月芽来的太早，等出发的时候，也不过才九点钟。

还好她还算有点良心，知道来的时候，给吴姜带份早餐。

李月芽心情正好，也没让吴姜开车，心甘情愿的给他当司机，设置好目的地，就向着民俗小镇出发了。

吴姜担心的高速大堵车，居然没有发生，虽然车流很多，但还是以每小时一百迈的速度到了目的地。

小镇的游客很多，两人到的第一件事，就是先找宾馆。

可惜，因为没有提前预定的关系，两人找了好半天，问了好几家宾馆，都没有空房，最后才在一家宾馆，开好了两间房间。

吴姜的心里隐隐还有些失落，他也不知道是什么原因。

One person and one ghost were playing with building blocks. When Nian Nian gently touched her hand, the blocks slowly flew up and landed exactly where they wanted to build them. Li Yueya looked on and exclaimed, "It's amazing."

"Wow, Nian Nian is so amazing!"

Li Yueya's emotional value was very good, and Niannian's desire to express herself became even stronger.

Wu Jiang half-leaned against the door frame of Nian Nian's princess room, looked at Li Yueya, and asked, "Tell me, why did you break into my house so early in the morning to find me?"

Li Yueya didn't even raise her head, and said confidently: "I have three days off on New Year's Day, you go out with me!"

Wu Jiang hesitated for a moment, then quickly nodded and agreed.

It's been a long time since the two of them went out alone to play. This summer vacation, they didn't even see each other because of their anger.

Moreover, Li Yueya had to go to class on weekdays and only had time during holidays. It was impossible for him to change the time.

Li Yueya had already chosen the place. It was a newly opened folk town about two hundred kilometers away from Green City. When she came, she was already sure that Wu Jiang would agree and brought her luggage and Wu Jiang's car.

Nian Nian was equally happy. Although she knew she couldn't go out during the day, she was so excited when she heard she could go out to play.

Fortunately, Li Yueya carries the amulet drawn by Wu Jiang, which can temporarily resist the Yin Qi on Nian Nian's body. Although it cannot be controlled for too long, there is still no problem in a short period of time when one person and one ghost come into contact.

Li Yueya came too early, and when it was time to set off, it was only nine o'clock.

Fortunately, she still had some conscience and knew to bring breakfast to Wu Jiang when she came.

Li Yueya was in a good mood and did not let Wu Jiang drive. She was willing to be his driver. After setting the destination, she set off towards the folk town.

The traffic jam on the highway that Wu Jiang was worried about did not happen. Although there was a lot of traffic, he still reached his destination at a speed of 100 miles per hour.

There are many tourists in the town, and the first thing the two of them did when they arrived was to find a hotel.

Unfortunately, because they didn't make a reservation in advance, the two of them searched for a long time and checked in several hotels, but there were no vacancies. Finally, they booked two rooms in a hotel.

Wu Jiang felt a little disappointed, and he didn't know why.
